body: Moved from docs/tasks/P1-instant-play-and-worst-bugs.md on 6 Nov 2026 (the task files hold the definition only; how far a task is lives on the board). **Status 2026-10-22: partly done.** The Top result of a search (or the first catalogue song) is prepared while the person reads (`SearchResultsView`); on the emulator a prepared Top result is audible 1.0-1.9 s after the tap. Not done: the first 3 songs of an opened album/playlist/imported playlist, the next 2 songs of the queue, cancelling stale prepares, dropping prepares first under back-off (P1-03).
